name: North Island
about: Summer (Dec–Feb) is warmest and driest, and the Crossing gets genuinely hazardous without winter gear Jun–Sep.
overview: Milder and busier than the South Island — Auckland's harbors, Rotorua's geothermal fields, Bay of Islands beaches, and the volcanic Tongariro Alpine Crossing.
costOverview: Coffee and buses are reasonable — the geothermal parks that define a Rotorua visit charge real admission, and prices climb fast for the fuller experiences.

specialSeasons.text: The Tongariro Alpine Crossing turns into a genuine winter mountaineering route this time of year — ice axe, crampons, and real experience required, not a casual day hike.
